hero.intro: Open-source schedule and booking software for dance and ballet schools: weekly timetables, class bookings, waiting lists, family accounts, prepaid passes and receipts.
hero.demo: This demo is the real app with a fictional school. It runs entirely in your browser: there is no server, and nothing you enter leaves your computer.
hero.signIn: Sign in with a demo account

schedule.title: Timetable and schedule
schedule.text: Terms, classes and one-off workshops become a schedule of lessons, released a set time ahead, as a list or a week grid.

booking.title: Bookings and waiting lists
booking.text: Members book and cancel within the school's rules. When a lesson is full, the waiting list invites the next in line.

family.title: Family accounts
family.text: Guardians book for their children; teenagers can have an account of their own.

passes.title: Passes and receipts
passes.text: Prepaid passes are redeemed as lessons take place, and every sale issues a numbered PDF receipt.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.text: Instructors see their lessons and participants, take attendance and add guests and trials.

office.title: Office and administration
office.text: Catalogue, timetable, persons, announcements, statistics, CSV import, duplicates, data export and anonymization.

devices.title: Calendar and phone
devices.text: Calendar feeds for any calendar app; installable as an app, with push notifications.

how.title: How the demo works
how.intro: GitHub Pages can only host static files, so the demo brings its own backend.
how.wasm: The complete Go backend is compiled to WebAssembly and runs in your browser, in a Web Worker. The interface talks to it through the same HTTP API as on a real server.
how.data: Instead of PostgreSQL it uses an in-memory database with fictional data, dated around your first visit.
how.saved: Your changes are kept in this browser until you choose “Reset demo” in the header, which also moves the sample dates to today.
how.mail: No email is sent: the demo mailbox in the header shows every mail the app would send, links included.
how.tab: The demo runs in one browser tab at a time, so your changes are saved in one place.
how.receipts: The first receipt you open loads the PDF renderer (about 9 MB).
how.same: Everything else, from validation and permissions to booking rules and receipts, is the same code as in a real installation.

try.title: Things to try
try.intro: Look around as a visitor, or sign in: the sign-in page lists one demo account per role, all with the password

visitor.title: Visitor
visitor.text: Browse the schedule and the classes, then register; the confirmation mail arrives in the demo mailbox.

member.title: Member
member.text: Book a lesson for one of the children, join the waiting list of a full workshop and subscribe to your lessons in a calendar.

instructor.title: Instructor
instructor.text: Open Teaching, take the attendance of a past lesson and add a guest to a workshop.

office.title: Office
office.text: Sell a pass on a person's page, write an announcement and look at the statistics.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.text: Change the school's name and colors in the settings, or sign in as another account from Accounts.
